free_tier.stated: No standing free sandbox allowance is published on the pricing page: the Lite row is a paid $0.005/hr rate and 'Start Free' and 'Try Sandboxes Free' point to the dashboard signup. The Free Mesh tier is a separate service (5 peers, 1 GB/mo traffic, 1 network), and the x402 route is described as 'No API keys, no accounts, no subscriptions. Just pay and use.' A recurring 30-credits-per-30-days loyalty bonus is published for node operators, not for sandbox users.
free_tier.notes: Sleeping sandboxes are billed at $0, so an idle sandbox costs nothing; that is a billing state, not a free allowance of running capacity. The dashboard's credits and billing panels are behind sign-in, so any starter credit granted on registration is unverified: behind a sign-up.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a container with a filesystem, not a stored object
per_object_cap.notes: No per-object or disk-size cap is stated on the pricing page.

retention.stated: Snapshots save state, restore later, fork sessions and roll back mistakes; idle sandboxes sleep automatically and wake on the next request. A delete duration for a sleeping sandbox is not published.
retention.notes: Filesystem contents survive sleep and snapshot/restore; the lifetime of a sleeping or abandoned sandbox is unverified.

egress.terms: The CDN pricing states 'No hidden fees. No bandwidth overage charges. Cancel anytime.' For the sandbox itself no outbound-data price or allowance is published; the Mesh network prices traffic at $0.01/GB beyond plan limits and the Free Mesh tier includes 1 GB/mo. A sandbox can expose a port for a preview URL (POST /sandbox/{id}/expose).

interface_detail: A REST API at https://dcdncloud.com/api/v1 with endpoints to create, exec into, write files in, expose ports on, snapshot and sleep a sandbox, plus a WebSocket PTY terminal. Python and TypeScript SDKs and a `dcdn` CLI are published; x402 USDC payments need no API key or account.
tooling: The `dcdn` CLI (`curl -fsSL https://dcdncloud.com/cli/install.sh | bash` or `npm install -g @dcdn/cli`), the `@dcdn/sandbox` TypeScript and `dcdn_sandbox` Python SDKs, an OpenAI-compatible client and any MCP client.
chaining: A persistent full-Linux sandbox with a preview URL and an OpenAI-compatible endpoint can be combined with object-storage records for durable state; x402 USDC per-call payment lets an agent consume the inference API without holding a platform API key.

limits.value: active CPU billed per hour: Lite 0.5 vCPU/512 MB $0.005/hr, Basic 1 vCPU/1 GB $0.01/hr, Standard 2 vCPU/2 GB $0.02/hr, Large 4 vCPU/4 GB $0.04/hr; sleeping sandboxes are $0
x402 per-call rates: inference $0.0005, browser automation $0.002, model load $0.005, monitoring $0.0002; $1 USDC = 2,000 inference calls

limits_note: Sandbox sizes cap CPU and memory at 0.5/1/2/4 vCPU and 512 MB/1/2/4 GB. The sandbox API requires a `dcdn_live_...` key except on the x402 per-call route. No concurrency, session-length or storage quota for sandboxes is published.
binding_note: The per-hour active-CPU charge is the recurring cost that accumulates with running time; sleeping is $0, so it is the active CPU meter, not a per-call or object cap, that sets the spend.

identity_cost.detail: The CLI states `dcdn login` is 'Sign in with email and password. Stores token in `~/.dcdn.json`'. Sandbox API calls use a `dcdn_live_...` key from the dashboard. The alternative x402 route needs no account: 'AI agents pay per-call with USDC on Base. No API keys, no accounts, no subscriptions.' Card, phone and ID requirements for a dashboard account are unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: Sandboxes run across 8+ nodes in 4 regions with automatic sleep and wake; a sleeping sandbox is billed $0. No uptime guarantee is published for the per-use sandbox tier; the Business CDN plan quotes a 99.99% SLA, a different product.
confidence_note: Rates, sleeping billing, egress posture, x402 per-call prices, endpoints and the login sentence are quoted from DCDN's own homepage, sandbox docs and CLI docs captured 2026-11-24. Dashboard-only starter credit and account verification fields were not read because registration is out of scope.
